svg.title: Cold connection delivery overhead
svg.desc: Matched nginx test setups: stock 5,421 bytes and optimized 4,432 bytes, a difference of 989 bytes. A separate archived Cloudflare control measured 6,203 bytes. An October 26 live median of three measured 5,252 bytes with a different certificate. TLS bytes through the first complete HTTP/2 page response, less the entire encoded body; excludes TCP/IP, DNS and connection close.
svg.text: TLS bytes through first complete HTTP/2 response, minus the encoded page body
Same test certificate chain · median of 3
989 B fewer in this fixture; results vary by setup
October 26 live median of 3: 5,252 B, measured with a different certificate.
The archived control and live result are not matched with the nginx test setups.
Excludes TCP/IP, DNS and connection-close traffic.
